finding.title: Mixed && / || without parentheses; space handling inconsistent
finding.message: Operator precedence with && and || is mixed in the condition, which is hard to read and risks mistakes. The new test case {' ', CodeSpacebar} depends on the rune being ignored. A later switch also handles CodeSpacebar but not the unknown-code rune, so fallthrough behavior for ' ' with CodeUnknown on non-preview lists is unhandled.
finding.suggestion: Add explicit parentheses around the && clause, and extract an isPlainSpace(e) helper used consistently for both preview and the later switch.
finding.evidence: if (e.KeyCode() == key.CodeSpacebar || e.KeyCode() == key.CodeUnknown && e.KeyRune() == ' ') && e.Modifiers() & ^((1<<key.CapsLock)|(1<<key.NumLock)) == 0
